run_relax_job: run a geometry optimization job on an ASE Atoms object using a calculator and optimizer flags
run_single_point_job: run a single-point energy and force calculation on an ASE Atoms object with a calculator
run_conformers: run geometry optimizations on molecular conformers organized by molecule family using a calculator
run_spin_gap: run single-point calculations on structures at different spin states to evaluate spin gap energies
run_singlepoint: run general single-point energy and force calculations on arbitrary molecular structures using a calculator
